scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,server "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.typecheck: npm run check -w @elaine/protocol && npm run check -w @elaine/server && npm run check -w @elaine/runner && npm run check -w @elaine/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:core -w @elaine/server && npm run check:api -w @elaine/server && npm run check:runner -w @elaine/runner && npm run build
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run dev:server
